items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...there's a tremendous musician by the name of Sam Wooding... And another helluva guy by the name of Charlie Dixon doing the arrangements... [INTERVIEWEE] I wasn't with Sam Wooding at all. I just stopped by.

ctx.x: He's not talking about Broadway Jones, is he?

I don't know. Anyhow, just stopped by one night and there's a tremendous musician by the name of Sam Wooding, he has the band there. And another helluva guy by the name of Charlie Dixon doing the arrangements, you know.
Oh, he was with Sam Wooding?
